requirements.title: Raw IMU Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept raw IMU sample records and write them to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-022, raw IMU samples must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.

requirements.title: Raw Barometer Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept raw barometer sample records and write them to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-001 and SW-REQ-SYS-022, raw barometer samples must be persisted to the SD card.

requirements.title: Raw GPS NMEA Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept raw GPS NMEA sentences and write them verbatim to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-024, raw GPS NMEA sentences must be preserved verbatim for post-flight reconstruction.

requirements.title: Navigation State Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept navigation state records and write them to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-022, navigation state estimates must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.

requirements.title: AFM Phase Event Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept flight phase event records and write them to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-022, AFM flight phase events must be persisted to the SD card for post-flight analysis.

requirements.title: GPS UTC Time Record API
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept GPS UTC time records and write them to non-volatile storage.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-028, GPS UTC time records enable post-flight alignment of monotonic time to absolute UTC.

requirements.title: Per-Record Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp
requirements.description: The mlog library shall stamp every written record with a monotonic microsecond timestamp.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-026 and SW-REQ-SYS-027, every record (including per-sample raw records) must carry a monotonic microsecond stamp.

requirements.title: New Run Created at Initialization
requirements.description: The mlog library shall create a new log run on each initialization.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-025, each power-on must start a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.

requirements.title: Prior Run Preservation
requirements.description: The mlog library shall not overwrite or delete any prior log run.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-055, prior log runs must be preserved on the SD card until externally wiped.

requirements.title: Machine-Parseable Record Format
requirements.description: The mlog library shall write records in a machine-parseable format that identifies each record's type.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-023, log records must be machine-parseable; specific format details are deferred to design.

requirements.title: Write Failure Status Propagation
requirements.description: The mlog library shall return a failure status to the caller when the underlying SD write fails.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-035 and SW-REQ-SYS-060, SD write failures must be observable so callers can flag the SD unhealthy and continue.

requirements.title: Continue After Write Failure
requirements.description: The mlog library shall accept and attempt subsequent record writes after a prior write failure.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-035, the FSW must continue attempting SD writes after a write failure rather than halting.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The mlog library shall provide functionally equivalent behavior on the POSIX and Pico2 builds.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-043, the POSIX build must be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build for Trick simulation.

requirements.title: Deterministic Record Output
requirements.description: The mlog library shall produce identical written record byte sequences given identical input record sequences.
requirements.rationale: Per SW-REQ-SYS-044, deterministic output is required for repeatable Trick simulation runs and regression analysis.
